name: API Route Safety Review
description: Before writing to any API route, verify the change includes error handling and fallback data so the app remains demo-able

then.prompt: Before applying this write operation, check: if this is an API route file (src/app/api/**), confirm the change includes a try/catch that returns fallback/mock data on failure rather than throwing a 500. The app must always be demo-able even when external APIs are down.
